    12→@Service
    13→class CatalogAssembleService(
    14→    private val proxyApplicationService: ProxyApplicationService,
    15→) {
    16→    fun assemble(documents: List<ChangedData<Catalog>>): List<IndexDocument<CatalogDocument>> {
    17→        val dependencyId = getDependencyId(documents)
    18→        val dependency = proxyApplicationService.fetchDependencies(dependencyId)
    19→
    20→        return documents.map {
    21→            // Note. CREATE 시 fetchDependencies()로부터 category, brand, manufacturer를 모두 받아와야 CatalogDocument를 생성할 수 있다.
    22→            if (it.op == Operation.CREATE) {
    23→                require(it.afterData != null) {
    24→                    "Failed to assemble catalog. afterData must not be null for create operation"
    25→                }
    26→                require(
    27→                    dependency.categories[it.afterData!!.categoryId] != null &&
    28→                        dependency.brands[it.afterData!!.brandId] != null &&
    29→                        dependency.manufacturers[it.afterData!!.manufacturerId] != null,
    30→                ) {
    31→                    "Failed to assemble catalog. Category, Brand, and Manufacturer must not be null. catalogId=[${it.id}]"
    32→                }
    33→            }
    34→
    35→            it.toIndexDocument(
    36→                category = dependency.categories[it.afterData?.categoryId],
    37→                brand = dependency.brands[it.afterData?.brandId],
    38→                manufacturer = dependency.manufacturers[it.afterData?.manufacturerId],
    39→            )
    40→        }
    41→    }

    45→        val brandIds: MutableList<Long> = mutableListOf()

    34→            redisTemplate
    35→                .opsForHash<String, String>()
    36→                .get(cacheKey, keyword)
